subject.title: Remove pre-2026.4 compatibility shims and legacy migrations

question: Should a release containing this cleanup formally require still-unmigrated pre-2026.4 installations to upgrade through a 2026.6 release first?
rationale: Repository policy favors deleting old compatibility paths, but changing the oldest supported direct-upgrade boundary is a release-contract choice that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve stepping-stone contract
options.body: Land the cleanup after the PR proves that a 2026.6 release performs every removed persistent-state migration and clearly documents the required upgrade sequence.

options.title: Preserve migration-only support
options.body: Keep only migration paths needed for direct upgrades from older shipped releases while removing dead runtime aliases and deprecated internal schemas.

recommendation.title: Approve stepping-stone contract
recommendation.body: Land the cleanup after the PR proves that a 2026.6 release performs every removed persistent-state migration and clearly documents the required upgrade sequence.

likelyOwner.reason: They defined the proposed upgrade contract, authored the candidate implementation, and have the strongest current history across the affected surfaces.
